query: Is there a deep orange soy candle with a free return policy if I don't like it?

products.title: Fresh Squeezed Soy Candle
products.description: A bright and invigorating citrus-scented soy candle featuring a blend of bold bergamot, tangy blood orange, and balancing cedar. Hand-poured in Bend, Oregon, this candle is crafted from 100% U.S.-grown soybean wax and cotton core wicks for a clean, vegan-friendly burn.
key_features: Scent notes of Bergamot, Blood Orange, and Cedar
Cotton core wicks for a clean burn

products.title: Cranberry Orange Soy Candle
products.description: A hand-poured soy candle with a quintessential seasonal scent featuring tart cranberry and zesty citrus balanced with warm spices. It is made from 100% U.S.-grown soybean wax with a cotton core wick, and is vegan, gluten-free, paraben-free, and phthalate-free.

products.title: Moroccan Terracotta Soy Candle
products.description: Handcrafted in Marrakesh, Morocco, this Moroccan Terracotta Soy Candle features a warm amber scent housed in a handmade glazed terracotta vessel. The natural soy wax creates a soothing atmosphere, and once the candle is burned through, the rustic cup can be repurposed as a decorative accent, a small storage container, or a coffee cup.
key_features: Handmade glazed terracotta cup crafted by artisans in Marrakesh, Morocco
Natural soy wax blended with a rich amber fragrance
Reusable vessel can be repurposed for coffee, storage, or home decor

products.title: Moroccan Terracotta Soy Candle
products.description: A handmade terracotta glazed candle vessel from Morocco houses amber scented soy wax. Crafted in Marrakesh, each cup features hand-glazed finishes with a cream and terracotta color block. The candle offers a warm amber aroma, and once burned, the ceramic cup can be repurposed as a decorative piece or small storage. Specifications include a compact size and weight, with care instructions noting hand-washing due to terracotta’s porous nature and minor glaze cracking that may occur from artisanal production.
key_features: Cream and terracotta color block glaze
Dimensions: approx 2.5 inches height x 2.6 inches diameter

products.title: Sunkissed In Bermuda Fresh Glass Candle
products.description: Experience the exotic allure of Bermuda with the Glasshouse Fragrances Sunkissed In Bermuda Fresh Glass Candle. This luxurious candle features a vibrant blend of tangelo, grapefruit, and wild geranium, evoking the feeling of warm sun on your skin and a gentle ocean breeze. Crafted with a premium soy wax blend and a cotton wick, it offers an impressive 80-hour burn time. Housed in an elegant glass vessel, this candle is perfect for creating a serene and uplifting atmosphere in any space.

products.title: Wellness Soy Candle
products.description: The Woolzies Wellness Soy Candle is a 100% natural soy wax candle designed to create a bright and balanced atmosphere. Scented with a blend of Orange and Ylang Ylang essential oils, it offers a fresh, uplifting aroma with juicy citrus and soft floral notes. This eco-friendly candle provides up to 55 hours of burn time and comes in a beautiful, gift-ready presentation, making it ideal for home fragrance, self-care routines, or gifting.
key_features: Scented with Orange & Ylang Ylang Essential Oils
Perfect for home fragrance, self-care & gifting

products.title: Holiday Hearth Soy Candle
products.description: Bring the warmth of the season home with the Woolzies Holiday Hearth Soy Candle. This cozy scent is a blend of Amber, Sandalwood, and Vanilla, designed to create an inviting fragrance perfectly suited for holiday evenings. Made with 100% natural soy wax and essential oils, it comes in an 11 oz (325 ml) jar with a burn time of up to 55 hours, making it an ideal choice for festive home décor or thoughtful seasonal gifting.

products.title: Soy Candle
products.description: Capture the vibrant essence of Los Angeles with this hand-poured soy candle. Featuring a complex fragrance blend of redwood, lime, jasmine, and yarrow, this candle evokes images of canyon drives and city sunsets. It is housed in an amber jar with a stylish brass lid and finished with a kraft label. Perfect for setting a magical ambiance on any surface.
key_features: Made with 100% domestically grown soy wax
Fragrance notes: redwood, lime, jasmine, and yarrow
Hand-poured in amber jar with brass lid and kraft label
